errors.what: First campaign aimed --target at ventures/shift-roster-builder/demand.mjs without probing; its suite is the whole venture glob, far over 10 min, and the foreground command was killed at 550 s. The file was restored (git status clean).

doc_friction.issue: Warns that --target skips the probe, but `targets --probe 20` lists only a sample, so a recently changed file may not appear and there's no single-file probe; I had to time the venture glob by hand. A `targets --probe 20 --only <file>` would help.

The stop hook asks to commit uncommitted changes while a mutation campaign holds a live mutant in a tracked file. Following it would commit a seeded bug; the hook should skip while redteam.py campaign is running.

real_defects.issue: carryOverTrySeed: a typed seed of about 1e21 or more (readSpec keeps any finite number) made seed * 7919 swamp i * 104729 in floating point, so tries 1-9 of the 'ten searches' got one seed (2 distinct seeds of 10). Fixed by folding an unsafe seed to seed >>> 0 (what mulberry32 reads) before mixing; every seed whose product is a safe integer keeps its exact tries. Test: best-of-k.test.mjs 'a huge typed seed...'.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a senior engineer running mutation tests over a 1,500-line module, triaging three escapes and fixing one numeric bug

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
